sloka: अयुक्तं तु विना देवीं दृष्टवद्भिश्च वानराः ।समीपं गन्तुमस्माभी राघवस्य महात्मनः ।। ५.६०.२ ।।।।
transliteration: ayuktaṁ tu vinā devīṁ dṛṣṭavadbhiśca vānarāḥ ।samīpaṁ gantumasmābhī rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 5.60.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "O vanaras, you are known for your valour. I think, to tell Rama that we have seen Sita but not brought her is not proper".
